role: Introduce Tally as the form layer for a client workflow
subject: Meet Tally for form-to-workflow handoffs
preview_text: Send each submission as structured JSON to the endpoint that starts the workflow.
headline: Start a client workflow with a form
body:
We’re launching Tally, an online form builder that can hand each new submission to the endpoint starting a client workflow.

Configure a webhook, and Tally sends the response data to your chosen HTTP endpoint as structured JSON in a POST request. That gives you a concrete handoff to inspect before deciding how the rest of the workflow should run.

Separately, a Tally form can trigger workflows through Make, Zapier, or n8n, which can route the data to a CRM, database, billing tool, or messaging app.

Build one small form for an upcoming intake flow, submit a test response, and inspect what arrives. It’s a practical way to see whether the handoff fits that client’s stack before using it more broadly.
